what: The Time Calculator adds and subtracts hours, minutes and seconds, totals a timesheet, and converts between hours:minutes and decimal hours. It is built for the everyday jobs of adding up work hours, video lengths, exercise times and travel legs.
Totals are shown as h:mm:ss, in days, as decimal hours, minutes and seconds, and overnight shifts are handled automatically.
uses: Total the hours worked in a week, minus breaks, and work out pay.
Convert 7 h 45 min to 7.75 decimal hours.
Add up clip lengths for an edit or playlist.
tutorial: In the first section type hours, minutes and seconds on each line. Choose − in Sign to subtract a line.
Press "Add a line". Use ✕ to remove one, or "Clear" to start over.
See the total as h:mm:ss, in days, as decimal hours, minutes and seconds.
For each day enter the start time, end time and break in minutes. The hours for that day appear on the right.
Type the pay per hour to see the pay for the total.
Type decimal hours (7.75) or hours:minutes (7:45) in the converter to see the other.
features: 90 minutes or 3,600 seconds are handled correctly.
Shown clearly when you subtract more than you add.
An end time before the start time is counted past midnight.
Breaks are subtracted and pay is calculated.
Decimal hours to h:mm:ss and back; accepts 7h45 too.

example.title: Worked example: a week of shifts
example.text: Monday 09:00 to 17:30 with a 30-minute break is 8:00. A night shift from 22:00 to 06:15 with a 15-minute break is also 8:00. Together that is 16h 00m, or 16 decimal hours; at 12.50 an hour the pay is 200.00.

tips: Payroll systems usually want decimal hours, so use the decimal figure.
For time differences between time zones, use the Time Zone Converter.
Leave unused timesheet rows empty; they are ignored.
problems: The break is longer than the shift
Check the break minutes and the start and end times.
The converter says minutes must be below 60
Write 7:45, not 7:75. For more than 59 minutes, use decimal hours or the first section.
Time boxes may show AM/PM. Check you chose PM for afternoon times.
